title: Colour conversions
description:
Write ImGui's colour conversions yourself:

```cpp
struct Vec4 { float r, g, b, a; };

uint32_t col32(int r, int g, int b, int a);                 // like IM_COL32: (a << 24) | (b << 16) | (g << 8) | r
uint32_t toU32(const Vec4& c);                              // floats 0..1 to bytes, rounded to nearest, clamped
Vec4     toVec4(uint32_t packed);                           // bytes to floats: byte / 255
void     rgbToHsv(float r, float g, float b, float& h, float& s, float& v);   // all in 0..1, hue too
bool     parseHex(const std::string& text, Vec4& out);      // "#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA"
```

- `toU32`: each float is clamped to 0..1, multiplied by 255 and rounded to the nearest whole number (`+ 0.5` then truncate).
- `rgbToHsv`: `v` is the largest of r, g, b; `s` is `(max - min) / max` (0 when max is 0); hue is in sixths of a turn: if max is r, `h = (g - b) / (max - min)`; if max is g, `h = 2 + (b - r) / (max - min)`; if max is b, `h = 4 + (r - g) / (max - min)`; then divide by 6 and add 1 if negative. For a grey (max equal to min) the hue is 0.
- `parseHex`: a `#` then exactly 6 or 8 hexadecimal digits (either case). Without alpha digits, alpha is 1. Anything else returns `false`.
